# anthropic_user (Resource)

Manages the organization role of an existing member. Members join through invites or SSO, so this resource is **import-only**: `terraform import anthropic_user.<name> user_...`. Applying a configuration for a user that is not in state fails.

Works with `admin_api_key`/`oauth_token` (Console organizations) and `enterprise_api_key` (Claude Enterprise).

Admins and owners cannot be modified or removed through the API. Destroy only removes the member from the organization when `remove_on_destroy = true`; by default it just drops the resource from state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Members join through invites or SSO. Import an existing member, then manage
# the organization role here.
resource "anthropic_user" "jane" {
  role = "developer"
}

# Opt in to removing the member from the organization on destroy.
resource "anthropic_user" "contractor" {
  role              = "user"
  remove_on_destroy = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role` (String) Organization role: `user`, `developer`, `billing`, `claude_code_user` (Console) or `user`, `managed` (Claude Enterprise).

### Optional

- `remove_on_destroy` (Boolean) Remove the member from the organization when the resource is destroyed. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `added_at` (String) Timestamp the member joined (RFC 3339).
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `id` (String) User id (`user_...`).
- `name` (String) Display name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import anthropic_user.jane user_01ExampleUserId0000000000
```
